sentences.text: This animal belonged to the class Placodermi, a group of armored fish that are now extinct.
Scientists classify it as a single-species genus within the arthrodire subgroup.
Gross first described this genus in 1932.
Fossils were discovered in Bad Wildungen, Germany.
It belongs to the family Trematosteidae and the superfamily Incisoscutoidea.
It lived during the Late Frasnian stage of the Late Devonian period, between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago.
